From the owner
Remodeling Contractor & Handyman in Panorama City Repairs & Remodels Fix Brothers is a licensed and insured general contractor serving Panorama City, about 15 minutes from our shop. Panorama City is multi-unit territory: apartment and condo renovations, unit turnovers, balcony rebuilds under SB 721 and SB 326, plus affordable kitchen and bath remodels in 1950s tract homes. Panorama City is an easy run east from our Chatsworth shop. It is one of the densest parts of the Valley, with a heavy mix of apartment buildings, condos and modest single-family homes, and a good share of our work here is for owners and managers of multi-unit property. Need something smaller? Our in-house handyman crew handles repairs, installs and punch-list work in Panorama City too, with the same fixed written pricing and the same two brothers running the job.

We can give your space a breathtaking transformation without the stress of a full remodel. Trust NYC’s local specialists and contact us today to discuss your cabinet restoration project.
